# Awesome AI Product Video Workflows

> Open workflows and worked cases for turning product images, ecommerce listings, and product briefs into hero visuals, video ads, UGC ads, and social media variants.

Primary repository: https://github.com/HiAPIAI/awesome-ai-video-workflows

## Start

- Skill instructions: SKILL.md
- English overview: README.md
- Chinese overview: README.zh-CN.md
- Upstream audit: docs/open-source-foundations.md
- GitHub discovery strategy: docs/github-discovery-strategy.md

## Workflows

- Product image audit: workflows/01-product-image-audit.md
- Product image to hero visual: workflows/02-product-image-to-hero-visual.md
- Hero visual to product video: workflows/03-hero-visual-to-product-video.md
- Product page to video ad: workflows/04-product-page-to-video-ad.md
- UGC product video ad: workflows/05-ugc-product-video-ad.md
- Social variants and QC: workflows/06-social-variants-and-qc.md

## Examples

- Real clip-light UGC ad: examples/clip-light-ugc-ad/README.md
- Cinematic product launch recipe: examples/cinematic-product-launch/README.md
- Catalog to social variants recipe: examples/catalog-to-social-variants/README.md
